evidence: TBTDET was contained in a bubbler which was heated at 70°C and carried by an argon flow rate of 35 cm3/min. One deposition cycle consists of an exposure to a metallorganic precursor of TBTDET, a purge period with an argon flow rate of 35 cm3/min, and an exposure to hydrogen plasma, followed by another purge period with an argon flow rate of 35 cm3/min.
